I was driving home on a weekday afternoon when the car in front of me slowed suddenly, and I braked as hard as I
could. The vehicle that came toward me from the opposite lane had drifted over the center line, and despite my efforts
to steer away, our front bumpers met at low speed. Both airbags stayed closed, and both cars could still be driven
from the scene, though neither was undamaged. Within a few hours I noticed a stiff ache spreading across my neck
and lower back, which has since been diagnosed as a strain. I have described the events the same way each time I
have spoken about them, whether to the responding officer, the medical staff, or the adjuster. I am the named driver

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
